primer: Microsoft (MSFT) is a premier enterprise software and hyperscale cloud compounder. In audited FY26, revenue reached $331.84B with a 46.8% operating margin and 24.20% ROIC. At $523.88 (21.71x forward P/E), the stock coils in a Stage 2 VCP squeeze on its 50-day SMA ($519.00). We assign IMMEDIATE_BUY for new capital ($660 target, $452.41 stop) and KEEP_COMPOUNDING on existing shares.
